heading.en: Pick the smallest, put it first

hook.en: To line up students by height, you could find the shortest student and bring them to the front, then the next shortest, and so on. That is selection sort.
hook.kn: ಎತ್ತರದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳನ್ನು ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಲು ಅತಿ ಕುಳ್ಳನನ್ನು ಮುಂದೆ ತಂದು, ನಂತರ ಮುಂದಿನವನನ್ನು ತರುತ್ತೇವೆ. ಇದೇ ಸೆಲೆಕ್ಷನ್ ಸಾರ್ಟ್.

narration.en: To line up students by height, you could find the shortest student and bring them to the front, then the next shortest, and so on. That is selection sort.
narration.kn: ಎತ್ತರದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳನ್ನು ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಲು ಅತಿ ಕುಳ್ಳನನ್ನು ಮುಂದೆ ತಂದು, ನಂತರ ಮುಂದಿನವನನ್ನು ತರುತ್ತೇವೆ. ಇದೇ ಸೆಲೆಕ್ಷನ್ ಸಾರ್ಟ್.

body.en: The list is treated as two parts: a sorted part on the left (empty at first) and an unsorted part on the right. In each pass, the smallest element of the unsorted part is selected and swapped with the leftmost element of the unsorted part, so the sorted part grows by one. After n − 1 passes the list is sorted. Each pass makes at most one swap.

points.en: Find the minimum of the unsorted part
Swap it with the leftmost unsorted element
